level_names.admin1: province (welaýat) or the city of Ashgabat (OSM admin_level 4)

tips.plate/area-code/calling-code: plate region letters (the last two letters of a white plate: AG Ashgabat, AH Ahal, AK Arkadag, BN Balkan, DZ Daşoguz, LB Lebap, MR Mary) or landline code (12 Ashgabat, three or four digits elsewhere, after +993 or the trunk 8) readable → `clues.py lookup plate|area-code <value> --country tm` + `board.py apply`
tips.livery: car colour is not a free choice in Ashgabat: non-white cars were effectively banned there by 2018, so a street of white cars points to the capital; read the plate letters (`clues.py lookup plate <two letters> --country tm`)
